title: Design and installation of plumbing fixtures.
officialText:
Integral fixture fitting mounting surfaces on manufactured plumbing fixtures or
plumbing fixtures constructed on site, shall meet the design requirements of ASME A112.19.2M or ASME A112.19.3M.
SECTION PC 406
AUTOMATIC CLOTHES WASHERS
